verdict.rationale: Poly has no dedicated export feature. Its own desktop sync and CLI do let you pull files out in their native formats: files appear as a real folder in Finder/Explorer, pinning a folder downloads everything inside it, `poly cp` copies from Poly to local disk, and journal entries are stored as Markdown files. missing for 10: a documented one-click whole-account export, export of Mind memories and metadata (tags, version history) in open formats, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a complete exit path.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can export my entire knowledge base at any time in open formats, so leaving is as easy as arriving

citations.quote: your Poly files appear as a real folder in Finder or Explorer, with files downloading on demand and syncing back automatically.
Keep Downloaded (pinned) — the content is downloaded eagerly and never evicted. Pinning a folder cascades to everything inside it.
cp — Copy between local disk and Poly, or within Poly
New journal entries are Markdown files synced to your **Mind** folder.
